name: REA
description: Reverse engineer shipped apps with REA 6.1.0 (morluto/rea, MIT): Electron routes and IPC, APKs, .NET, native binaries. Static tools only; nothing runs the target. REA is not a sandbox: analyse only files you trust. Analysis results go to your agent's model provider.

settings.label: Tools your agents get
settings.description: Core: the 27 most used tools (about 13k tokens). Full: all 108 static tools (about 104k tokens), which crowds a smaller model's context.

settings.label: Disassembler
settings.description: Which engine opens native programs. Automatic picks the one that is set up.

settings.label: Ghidra folder
settings.description: Absolute path of an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x release (for native programs).

settings.label: Java (JDK) folder
settings.description: Absolute path of a JDK 21 or newer. Leave empty when java is on the PATH.

settings.label: Ghidra start timeout (ms)
settings.description: Raise it for very large programs.

settings.label: JADX MCP JAR
settings.description: Absolute path of a jadx-headless-mcp 0.7.1 JAR (for Android apps).

settings.label: Wakaru command
settings.description: Absolute path of Wakaru 1.13.0 (readable code from a bundle).

settings.label: Python with pwntools
settings.description: Absolute path of a Python that has pwntools 4.15.0 (ELF layout and crash dumps).

settings.label: Unblob command
settings.description: Absolute path of Unblob 26.6.x (firmware), as an alternative to Binwalk.

settings.label: IDA MCP registration
settings.description: Only with your own IDA Pro license: path of your IDA MCP registration JSON.

settings.label: Hopper launcher
settings.description: Only with your own Hopper license: path of its launcher.
